# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

Security updates and patches are actively maintained for the following versions:

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.0.x   | :white_check_mark: |
| < 1.0   | :x:                |

---

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of **Andromeda Music** seriously. If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it responsibly:

1. **Do not open a public issue.**
2. Report the vulnerability privately via **GitHub Security Advisories** on the repository page:
   `https://github.com/batatudev/andromeda-music/security/advisories/new`
3. Include detailed steps to reproduce the issue along with environment specifications (Linux distribution, display server, Python version).

We will acknowledge receipt of your report within 48 hours and coordinate a timely fix and release.
